title: FieldExist() and Field() get a text overload

chapters.title: Overview of FieldExist and Field overloads
Use case - accessing table extension fields
New text overload functions in latest compiler
Demo execution with field ID and field name

features.name: FieldExist() text overload
features.description: New overloaded version of FieldExist function that accepts a field name as text parameter instead of just integer field ID. Allows checking if a field exists by name rather than by numeric ID.

features.name: Field() text overload
features.description: New overloaded version of the Field function on RecordRef that accepts a field name as text parameter. Returns a FieldRef for the named field, enabling method chaining with the Value function.

features.name: Accessing table extension fields via text parameters
features.description: Use case for the new overloads enabling developers to access fields from third-party table extensions without knowing field IDs, using field names instead.
caveats: Requires knowing the field name as a string

objects.name: get value via field ID / get value via field name

quotes.text: in fact existing functions but microsoft created overloaded versions of these functions
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that FieldExist and Field are not new functions but new overloads of existing functions, important for developer understanding of the feature.

quotes.text: how can we get the value of a field that's not in the base application, but it's a field that belongs to a table
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the key use case that motivated these new overloads - accessing third-party extension fields without knowing numeric IDs.

quotes.text: with the latest release though we have uh an overloaded version of the field exist function and field exist as you can see here
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms that FieldExist text overload is available in the latest AL compiler release with changed functionality.

quotes.text: And not only field exist but also field has an overloaded version. We can now pass to field a field name.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms Field function also has a new text overload in addition to FieldExist, expanding options for field access.

quotes.text: We can chain the value function for a field ref. And that's pretty much it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows practical usage pattern enabling developers to chain Value() directly after Field() call for immediate value retrieval.
